issue_request: FHIR-19213 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked to change the Health Canada Drug Identification Number URI on terminologies-systems.html from http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/ca-hc-din to http://hl7.org/fhir/NamingSystem/ca-hc-din.
initial_application: The request was applied by a9a20cbe47, which changed the Health Canada DIN row in source/terminologies-systems.html to http://hl7.org/fhir/NamingSystem/ca-hc-din. The earlier FHIR-10228/GForge #10228 registration and Canada Zulip discussion support the same target URI.
additional_context: FHIR-37853 later changed the build-scoped Code Systems page to make THO authoritative for external terminology metadata and removed external rows without FHIR-specific usage pages, including the Health Canada DIN row. UP-176 temporarily moved Health Canada DIN metadata in THO, and UP-238 corrected the preferred URI so the current THO publication marks http://hl7.org/fhir/NamingSystem/ca-hc-din as preferred/official while retaining other URIs only for backward compatibility.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because re-adding a Health Canada DIN row to core would conflict with the later THO source-of-truth decision, and THO already satisfies FHIR-19213's requested URI.
